text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ouch!
Ugh... My arm feels like it has muscle pain, YES.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was doing some fast-draw
training last night, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I spin a model gun,
I just can't help getting all fired up...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
Can't we do something about this, YES...? Ow-ow-ow.
Taiki Shuttle seems to be out of shape...
